contexts: regional crisis text line run by a community agency with hospital psychiatry
volunteer responders with two counsellors per shift
platform logs held by a vendor
two recorded searches returned no records
reading: Waiting sits between demand in the evening and a first-come queue that treats every texter alike. The protocol changes three things at once: acknowledgement, order and capacity. Whether it works depends on the keyword flag catching risk, on counsellors logging in when the surge roster calls, and on volunteers trusting the new order. Both recorded searches were empty, so every node below comes from the investigator's account and local facts, not from retrieved evidence.
